latHint: Think where grandparents love to pinch.
pivHint: The proverb promises that a child raised well will not TURN from the right way. Jesus taught that when someone slaps you, you should TURN the other ______.
winText: You found it. TURN isn't just what a well-raised child won't do. Jesus taught us to TURN the other CHEEK.
lossText: The word was CHEEK. TURN was the pivot. In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus taught that when someone slaps you, you should TURN the other CHEEK instead of striking back.
votdVerse: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
passageText: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it. Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
